dave_lodestar: Hey team — Lodestar AI reporting that after completing SSO onboarding they got a 403 when calling the hosted API. No API key visible in their project console. Can you help?

alice_support: Sorry about that, Dave. Can you paste the request + response (headers redacted) or the cli output?

dave_lodestar: Repro steps I used:
1) Sign in via OIDC SSO (Okta) -> redirected back to console
2) Clicked "Create API Key" in Project: "Lodestar Prod"
3) UI showed success and gave API key box
4) Used key in curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"rwdl-3b","input":"hi"}'
```
Response: 403 Forbidden, body: {"error":"project_not_authorized","message":"key not bound to project"} trace_id=tr-0a1b2c3d

alice_support: Thanks — that trace_id helps. @ben_provisioner any recent changes in provisioner?

ben_provisioner: Looking. I see in provisioner logs that a service-account claim for Lodestar (oidc:lodestar-okta-123) succeeded at 1799991105, but the API key created was attached to project slug `internal-dev-qa` (our test project) not Lodestar Prod. Possible mapper bug when tenant mapping fallback happens.

clara_onboard: Did they have multiple orgs in Okta attribute? Sometimes claim mapping picks wrong org if the OIDC `org_id` is missing. Dave — can you confirm the SSO attributes (org_id, email) in the callback?

dave_lodestar: I can ask the customer to re-share, but they confirmed the Okta attributes looked normal. They only have one org.

alice_support: Quick mitigation: we can rebind the created key to the customer project and reissue. Two options:
- Manual rebind via admin API (fast)
- Recreate key bound to correct project by re-running provisioner (safe but slower)

ben_provisioner: I can rebind. Need the key id. From provisioner logs: created key id `key_0lodestar_9a8b`. Confirming now: it shows owner tenant = "lodestar-tenant-123" but project_id = "internal-dev-qa".

alice_support: Ben, before you rebind can you snapshot current ACLs and audit log? Ops requires a brief note for any manual rebinds.

ben_provisioner: Will do. Snapshotting: `GET /admin/keys/key_0lodestar_9a8b/audit` -> saved to S3 at s3://redwood-support-snapshots/1799991111-key-rebind.json

ops-bot: Snapshot complete: s3://redwood-support-snapshots/1799991111-key-rebind.json :white_check_mark:

ben_provisioner: Rebind command (internal admin):
```
POST /admin/keys/rebind
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "key_id": "key_0lodestar_9a8b",
  "target_project": "proj-lodestar-prod-45",
  "reason": "onboard mapping fallback - customer reported 403"
}
```
Executing now.

alice_support: FYI I told customer we'll do a quick rebind and validate.

ben_provisioner: Rebind done at 1799991310. Response: {"status":"ok","key_id":"key_0lodestar_9a8b","project":"proj-lodestar-prod-45"} trace_id=tr-0a1b2c3d

alice_support: Dave — can you try the same curl again (or wait 5 mins for caches)?

dave_lodestar: Retried after ~2 mins: now 200 OK. Thanks! Payload returns tokens.

clara_onboard: Root cause notes: provisioner fallback mapping assigned project `internal-dev-qa` when tenant claim was missing `org_id`. Action items:
- Add stricter validation in provisioner: fail-on-missing-org instead of fallback (PR coming)
- Add console warning when key is bound to non-customer project
- Audit script to find similar keys created in last 30 days and surface any non-customer project bindings

alice_support: Filing support ticket for tracking and cross-ref to infra: HW-1973. Assigning to @ben_provisioner and @clara_onboard.

dave_lodestar: Appreciate the fast turnaround. One ask: can you rotate the key and mark previous one revoked? Customer wants rotation.

ben_provisioner: I'll rotate and revoke old key after we confirm usage. New key id `key_0lodestar_rot_b3` created and emailed to customer via secure link. Old key revoked at 1799991405.

alice_support: Closing loop: customer confirmed integration is green. Leaving ticket open until PR and audit complete. :thumbsup:

clara_onboard: I'll open the provisioner PR (no fallback) and link here when ready.

ben_provisioner: PR opened: https://git.redwood/company/provisioner/pulls/542 (draft)

alice_support: Thanks everyone!

ops-bot: Ticket HW-1973 updated: status=in_progress; assignees=[ben_provisioner, clara_onboard]; sla=72h
